about_long: Amara Njeri is a sample profile used to show how this portfolio template works. She is a fictional Nairobi-based fashion, beauty and portrait photographer.
On your own site this section tells your story: the kind of work you love, who you have worked with, and what it feels like to book you.
Everything on these pages, from portfolio categories and photos to services, prices and contact details, is edited from one simple content file.
svc_intro: Sessions, editorial days and brand campaigns. Sample prices in Kenyan shillings: set your own in the content file.

categories.name: Portraits
body: Portraits built on light and patience. Amara works slowly with every sitter, so the final frame feels like the person rather than the pose.
Sessions take place in the studio or on location in Nairobi, with natural or controlled light depending on the mood you want.

categories.name: Beauty
body: Clean, close beauty work for skincare, hair and jewellery brands, retouched to keep real skin texture.
Amara works with your make-up artist and stylist, or can bring a trusted team.

categories.name: Editorial
body: Concept-led fashion stories for magazines, designers and lookbooks, from mood board to final edit.
Bold colour, graphic styling and a sense of play: images made to stop the scroll.

categories.name: Brand & lifestyle
body: Campaign and lifestyle imagery for fashion labels, cafés and lifestyle brands: images that sell a feeling, not just a product.
Every campaign comes with web and social crops, ready for your launch.

terms: Edited images delivered within 7 working days
